description: This file defines event handling functions and types for the internal event system in Go, including logging, error reporting, metrics, labeling, span management, and event identification.

methods.name: SetExporter
methods.description: Sets the global event exporter function.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Creates and exports a log event with a message and labels.

methods.name: IsLog
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Log.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Creates and exports an error event with a message and error.

methods.name: IsError
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Error.

methods.name: Metric
methods.description: Exports a metric event with labels.

methods.name: IsMetric
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Metric.

methods.name: Label
methods.description: Exports a label event with labels.

methods.name: IsLabel
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Label.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a span with a name and labels, returns context and end function.

methods.name: IsStart
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Start.

methods.name: IsEnd
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by End.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Returns a context without an associated span.

methods.name: IsDetach
methods.description: Checks if an event was created by Detach.
